text: I have received numerous complaints from local residents about ice cream trucks idling for hours in front of residences along Marine Parade Drive. Residents have repeatedly reported strong smells of propane, noisy generators, and illegal parking. This motion seeks to shift the permitted operating areas of ice cream trucks along Marine Parade Drive away from local residences.

The Etobicoke York Community Council 1. Amended Municipal Code Chapter 740, Schedule D, Ice Cream Vending Permit Locations by deleting the following locations: Delete from: Highway Delete from: Between Property Address Number (on one side) Delete from: Between Property Address Number (on the other side) Marine Parade Drive 1-3 Marine Parade Drive 5-5 Marine Parade Drive 58-110 Marine Parade Drive 15-15 Waterfront Drive 2. Amended Municipal Code Chapter 740, Schedule D, Ice Cream Vending Permit Locations by adding the following locations: Add to: Highway Add to: Between Property Address Number (on one side) Add to: Between Property Address Number (on the other side) Marine Parade Drive Park Frontage of 2115 Lake Shore Boulevard West onto Marine Parade Drive, on south-east side of highway
